name: sidar_settler
description: a Sidar Settler, a pale grey-skinned wanderer with pale grey eyes: a deep grey hood and a tattered ragged grey cloak over a teal tunic with a silver clasp at the throat, a brown belt with leather pouches, grey trousers and brown boots, a big tan canvas backpack on his back topped with a rolled dark-grey bedroll and a tin pot hanging from it on the screen-left, and a tall pale crooked wooden walking staff held upright in his LEFT hand
hands: the walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side grips the backpack strap at his chest as an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the crooked wooden staff is lifted up over the head with its top end pointing up and back, the big backpack on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the wooden staff cocked behind the head with its top end hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the backpack strap
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the wooden staff is level, its top end pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the top end of the wooden staff smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the wooden staff carries on down until its top end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the hood and the ragged cloak trailing back, the backpack swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the wooden staff lifts back toward its upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left inside the hood, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the wooden staff upright)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the wooden staff leaning out to the right, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the wooden staff high, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the hooded head droops, the wooden staff lowering, the heavy backpack dragging at his shoulders
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the top end of the wooden staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the big backpack, the wooden staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the grey hood still on his head and the big backpack under his shoulders; the wooden staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the bedroll, the tin pot and the ragged cloak settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back over the backpack, eyes closed, the grey hood on his head, the wooden staff on the ground beside him
